memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord's anger was aroused that day and he swore this oath: "Because they have not followed me wholeheartedly, not one of those who were twenty years old or more when they came up out of Egypt will see the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob—not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, for they followed the Lord wholeheartedly." - Num 32:10-12 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses recalls the painful consequences of that earlier unbelief. Because the older generation did not follow the Lord wholeheartedly, they were barred from the land they had longed for. The phrase that stands out is "wholeheartedly." God was not asking for a hesitant, half-hearted, hedge-your-bets kind of following. He wanted hearts fully given to Him.

Two men were the exception: Caleb and Joshua. What set them apart was not superior strength or cleverness, but wholehearted devotion. They trusted God fully when everyone else shrank back in fear. Their example shines across the centuries: it is possible to stand firm in faith even when the whole crowd is going the other way.

We should let this search our own hearts. Are we following God wholeheartedly, or only partly — obeying where it is convenient and holding back where it costs us? Divided hearts leave us weak and restless. God calls us to love Him with all our heart, soul, mind, and strength (Mark 12:30).

The wonderful news is that we do not muster this wholehearted love on our own. God Himself works in us to will and to act according to His good purpose (Phil 2:13). And where our devotion falters, we are held not by the strength of our grip on Christ, but by the strength of His grip on us. Ask Him today to make your heart fully His.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is your following of God whole-hearted or divided?
2. What area of your life are you holding back from Him?
3. How does it comfort you that God works wholehearted devotion in you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, forgive my divided heart. Make me like Caleb and Joshua, wholehearted in following You, and work in me both the desire and the strength to obey. Amen.
